ToolCUA：为计算机使用代理实现最佳 GUI 工具路径编排ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents

Xuhao Hu2,1,∗ Xi Zhang1,∗ Haiyang Xu1,† Kyle Qiao1 Jingyi Yang2
Xuanjing Huang2 Jing Shao3 Ming Yan1,† Jieping Ye1 {xuhaohu08}@gmail.com {zx443053}@alibaba-inc.com {shuofeng.xhy,ym119608}@alibaba-inc.com
摘要Abstract

计算机使用代理 (CUA) 可以通过原子 GUI 操作（Computer Use Agents (CUAs) can act through both atomic GUI actions (例如，单击、键入e.g., click, type）和高级工具调用（) and high-level tool calls (例如，基于 API 的文件操作e.g., API-based file operations），但他们常常对这种混合动作空间感到困惑：他们不知道何时继续 GUI 动作，何时切换到工具，最终无法选择最佳执行路径。 这个困难源于两个问题。 首先，高质量的交错 GUI 工具轨迹稀缺，而收集真实的工具轨迹既昂贵又脆弱。 其次，现有的监督为 GUI 工具路径选择提供了有限的指导，因为大多数方法侧重于步骤级动作模仿或最终任务完成，并且很少提供关于 GUI 工具切换是否会导致更有效的执行路径的轨迹级反馈。 在本文中，我们建议), but they are often confused by this hybrid action space: they do not know when to continue with GUI actions and when to switch to tools, and finally fail to select the optimal execution path. This difficulty stems from two issues. First, high-quality interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories are scarce, and collecting real tool trajectories is expensive and brittle. Second, existing supervision provides limited guidance for GUI-Tool path selection, as most methods focus on step-level action imitation or final task completion and offer little trajectory-level feedback on whether GUI-Tool switching leads to a more effective execution path. In this paper, we propose工具CUAToolCUA, 一个端到端代理，旨在通过分阶段训练范例学习最佳的 GUI 工具路径选择。 我们首先介绍一个, an end-to-end agent designed to learn optimal GUI-Tool path selection through a staged training paradigm. We first introduce an交错式 GUI 工具轨迹缩放管道Interleaved GUI-Tool Trajectory Scaling Pipeline它重新利用了丰富的静态 GUI 轨迹并综合了一个基础的工具库，使得无需手动工程或真实的工具轨迹收集即可扩展不同的 GUI 工具轨迹。 基于这些数据，我们执行工具引导 GUI RFT，它将预热 SFT 与单轮 RL 结合起来，以改进关键 GUI-工具切换点的决策。 最后，我们进一步优化 ToolCUAthat repurposes abundant static GUI trajectories and synthesizes a grounded library of tools, making it possible to scale diverse GUI-Tool trajectories without manual engineering or real tool-trajectory collection. Based on this data, we perform Tool-Bootstrapped GUI RFT, which combines warmup SFT with single-turn RL to improve decisions at critical GUI-Tool switching points. Finally, we further optimize ToolCUA with在线代理强化学习Online Agentic RL在高保真 GUI 工具环境中，使用in a high-fidelity GUI-Tool environment, using a工具高效路径奖励Tool-Efficient Path Reward这鼓励适当的工具使用和更短的执行路径。 OSWorld-MCP 上的实验表明，ToolCUA 的准确率达到了 46.85%，比基线相对提高了约 66%，在可比规模的模型中建立了新的技术水平。 它还比仅 GUI 设置提高了 3.9%，展示了有效的 GUI 工具编排。 结果进一步表明，混合行动空间中的训练对于现实世界的数字代理来说是一个有前途的范例。that encourages both appropriate tool use and shorter execution paths. Experiments on OSWorld-MCP show that ToolCUA achieves 46.85% accuracy, a relative improvement of approximately 66% over the baseline, establishing a new state of the art among models of comparable scale. It also improves by 3.9% over GUI-only settings, demonstrating effective GUI-Tool orchestration. The results further suggest that training in a hybrid action space is a promising paradigm for real-world digital agents.

We formalize this challenge, illustrated in Figure2, 作为, as最佳 GUI 工具路径选择optimal GUI-Tool path selection： 动态确定何时使用GUI操作、何时调用工具，从而形成高效可靠的任务轨迹。 与步骤级动作选择不同，这本质上是一个轨迹级策略学习问题，因为每个 GUI 到工具或工具到 GUI 的切换决策不仅解决了当前步骤，而且在效率和可靠性方面重塑了整个后续轨迹。: dynamically determining when to use GUI actions and when to invoke tools so as to form an efficient and reliable task trajectory. Unlike step-level action selection, this is inherently a trajectory-level policy learning problem, as each GUI-to-Tool or Tool-to-GUI switching decision not only solves the immediate step, but reshapes the entire subsequent trajectory in terms of efficiency and reliability.

为此，现有方法在两个基本方面存在不足。 首先，To this end, existing approaches fall short in two fundamental aspects. First,当前的 CUA 经常缺乏工具使用方面的培训，表现出工具调用知识的缺陷current CUAs are often undertrained on tool use, exhibiting a deficit in tool-calling knowledge。 这种限制的根源在于缺乏高质量的交错 GUI 工具轨迹。在真实的计算机使用环境中，可用的工具很难获得和维护。 具体来说，API 通常是特定于应用程序的、不完整或不稳定的，并且收集 GUI 工具数据需要昂贵的环境仪器。 现有努力. This limitation is rooted in the lack of high-quality interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories. In real computer-use environments, usable tools are difficult to obtain and maintain. Specifically, APIs are often application-specific, incomplete, or unstable, and collecting GUI-Tool data requires expensive environment instrumentation. Existing efforts[yang2025ultracua, yan2025step]通过从代码生成工具来部分解决这个问题，但这种管道的扩展成本仍然很高，并且不能充分利用大量现有的仅 GUI 轨迹语料库partly address this by generating tools from code, but such pipelines remain costly to scale and do not fully exploit the large amount of existing GUI-only trajectory corpora[jian2026cuasuit, wang2025opencua, liu2025scalecua, xie2024osworld, mu2025gui360, zhang2026tongui]。 其次，即使具备了基本的工具使用能力，现有的监管也提供了. Second, even when basic tool-use ability is available, existing supervision provides学习有效混合动作编排的指导有限limited guidance for learning effective hybrid action orchestration。 在实践中，当前的训练信号通常来自步骤级模仿或最终任务完成奖励。 前者仅捕获本地操作的合理性，而后者不区分及时的工具调用切换和漫长而脆弱的仅 GUI 解决方法。 因此，模型无法可靠地了解 GUI 操作和工具调用之间的切换是否改善了整个轨迹。. In practice, current training signals usually come from either step-level imitation or final task-completion rewards. The former one only captures local action plausibility, while the latter does not distinguish between a timely tool calling switch and a long, brittle GUI-only workaround. As a result, the model cannot reliably learn whether switching between GUI actions and tool calls improves the full trajectory.

为了应对这些挑战，我们引入To address these challenges, we introduce工具CUAToolCUA, 通过两阶段范式训练的统一代理模型： 第一阶段使用可扩展的交错 GUI 工具数据构建混合操作基础，第二阶段通过强化学习改进轨迹级 GUI 工具决策。 首先，我们提出一个, a unified agentic model trained through a two-stage paradigm: The first stage builds hybrid-action foundations with scalable interleaved GUI-Tool data, and the second stage improves trajectory-level GUI-Tool decisions through reinforcement learning. First, we propose an交错的 GUI 工具轨迹缩放管道interleaved GUI-Tool trajectory scaling pipeline建立在现有的静态 GUI 语料库上。 它采用 MLLM 从循环 GUI 程序合成轨迹感知工具库，并通过工具步骤生成和下一状态接地将纯 GUI 数据转换为交错的 GUI 工具轨迹。 通过重新利用现有的 GUI 语料库和综合工具，而不是收集昂贵的真实工具轨迹，该管道无需手动工程即可实现可扩展的数据构建，同时涵盖不同的工具粒度和切换上下文。 在此数据的基础上，我们执行工具引导 GUI 强化微调 (RFT)。它首先应用预热 SFT 来建立基本的混合操作功能，然后使用单轮 RL 来改进显式 GUI 工具切换点的决策。 最后，我们优化 ToolCUAbuilt on existing static GUI corpora. It employs MLLMs to synthesize a trajectory-aware library of tools from recurrent GUI procedures, and converts GUI-only data into interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories through tool steps generation and next-state grounding. By repurposing existing GUI corpora and synthesizing tools instead of collecting expensive real tool trajectories, this pipeline enables scalable data construction without manual engineering, while covering varied tool granularities and switching contexts. Building on this data, we perform Tool-Bootstrapped GUI Reinforcement Finetuning (RFT). It first applies warmup SFT to establish basic hybrid-action capabilities, and then uses single-turn RL to improve decisions at explicit GUI-Tool switching points. Finally, we optimize ToolCUA with在线代理强化学习Online Agentic RL在现实的 GUI 工具环境中in a realistic GUI-Tool environment with a工具高效路径奖励Tool-Efficient Path Reward，其中包括工具适当性术语, which includes a tool appropriateness termRt​o​o​lR_{tool}和路径效率项and path efficiency termRl​e​n​g​t​hR_{length}: Rt​o​o​lR_{tool}激励代理在有益时调用工具，在不必要时放弃，同时incentivizes the agent to invoke tools when beneficial and abstain when unnecessary, whileRl​e​n​g​t​hR_{length}通过用工具调用替换冗余的 GUI 操作来鼓励缩短执行路径。 它们共同提供轨迹级反馈，推动模型实现全局最优 GUI 工具路径选择。encourages shorter execution paths by replacing redundant GUI actions with tool calls. Together, they provide trajectory-level feedback that drives the model toward globally optimal GUI-Tool path selection.

Furthermore, ToolCUA trained with hybrid action spaces achieved 42.9% accuracy even in pure GUI action settings, and ToolCUA demonstrates a +3.9% improvement compared with pure GUI actions, demonstrating successful orchestration of GUI and Tool actions in optimal path selection. Additionally, ToolCUA shows out-of-distribution generalization across tasks and platforms, reaching 23.9% on unseen多应用程序multi_appsLinux 任务在看不见的情况下实现了 33.8%Linux tasks and achieving 33.8% on unseen窗户WindowsWindowsAgentArena 中的桌面应用程序desktop apps in WindowsAgentArena[bonatti2024windows]。 这些结果证实，在混合 GUI-工具操作空间中进行操作对于实现可推广且高​​效的现实世界数字自动化至关重要。 我们的主要贡献总结如下：. 2.2 交错式 GUI 工具轨迹缩放管道Interleaved GUI-Tool Trajectory Scaling Pipeline

为了解决交错 GUI 工具轨迹的稀缺问题， 我们建立了一个离线轨迹缩放管道，从To address the scarcity of interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories, we build an offline trajectory scaling pipeline that starts from现有的纯 GUI 轨迹existing pure GUI trajectories并将它们转换为交错的 GUI 工具数据。 如图and converts them into interleaved GUI-Tool data. As shown in Figure3(a)，关键思想是使用 MLLM ((a), the key idea is to use an MLLM (例如e.g.、Kimi-K2.5 或 Claude-4.5-Sonnet）来合成, Kimi-K2.5 or Claude-4.5-Sonnet) to synthesize a接地工具库grounded library of tools从循环的 GUI 程序中，然后使用这些工具将纯 GUI 轨迹转换为交错的 GUI 工具轨迹。 我们的管道沿着三个维度扩展数据：跨应用程序域的工具功能、从原子实用程序到复合技能的工具粒度，以及涵盖工具使用或多或少有益的情况的 GUI 工具切换上下文。 请参阅附录from recurrent GUI procedures, and then use these tools to transform GUI-only trajectories into interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories. Our pipeline scales data along three dimensions: Tool Functionality across application domains, Tool Granularity from atomic utilities to composite skills, and GUI-Tool Switching Context covering cases where tool use is more or less beneficial. Please refer to AppendixE对于我们使用的提示。 我们在下面描述主要步骤。for prompts we used. We describe the main steps below.

轨迹过滤和平衡。Trajectory Filtering and Balancing.我们从成功的原始 GUI 轨迹开始，并根据执行质量、任务长度和应用程序覆盖范围对其进行过滤。其余的轨迹在各个领域之间保持平衡，为工具综合提供稳定的源分布。We start from successful raw GUI trajectories and filter them by execution quality, task length, and application coverage. The remaining trajectories are balanced across domains to provide a stable source distribution for tool synthesis.

轨迹感知综合工具库构建。Trajectory-Aware Synthetic Tool Library Construction.对于每个 GUI 轨迹，我们利用 MLLM 通过分析纯 GUI 路径（包括任务目标、动作序列和密集的屏幕截图描述）来合成候选工具库。 每个综合工具将观察到的 GUI 过程抽象为可调用的高级操作，由功能签名、自然语言描述和从轨迹推断的参数语义指定。 这使得这些工具基于具体的轨迹行为，而不是通用 API 模板或手动预定义的函数。 增加For each GUI trajectory, we utilize an MLLM to synthesize a candidate library of tools by analyzing the pure GUI path, including the task goal, action sequences, and dense screenshot descriptions. Each synthesized tool abstracts an observed GUI procedure into a callable high-level operation, specified by a functional signature, natural language description, and argument semantics inferred from the trajectory. This makes the tools grounded in concrete trajectory behavior rather than generic API templates or manually predefined functions. To increase多样性diversity，我们综合工具 不同级别的特异性，来自单动作包装器（, we synthesize tools at varying levels of specificity, from single-action wrappers (例如，chrome_open_settingse.g., chrome_open_settings) 到多步复合函数 () to multi-step composite functions (例如，chrome_open_language_settingse.g., chrome_open_language_settings）。 基于规则的格式验证也应用于工具过滤。). A rule-based format verification is also applied for tool filtering.

具有下一状态基础的工具轨迹生成。Tool Trajectory Generation with Next-State Grounding.给定综合工具库和原始 GUI 轨迹，我们采用 MLLM 生成功能等效的纯工具轨迹。 对于每个步骤，MLLM 从库中选择适当的工具，生成思想链基本原理，并预测预期响应，并根据工具模式进行验证。 此外， 我们采用 MLLM 来执行Given the synthesized tool library and the original GUI trajectory, we adopt an MLLM to generate a functionally equivalent tool-only trajectory. For each step, the MLLM selects an appropriate tool from the library, produces a chain-of-thought rationale, and predicts the expected response, validated against the tool schema. Furthermore, we adopt an MLLM to perform下一状态接地next-state grounding, 即i.e.，将工具步骤锚定到原始轨迹中相应的下一状态屏幕截图，验证预测的执行效果和观察到的 GUI 状态之间的一致性。 此外，我们应用一个, anchor the tool step to a corresponding resulting next-state screenshot from the original trajectory, verifying consistency between predicted execution effects and observed GUI state. Besides, we apply a自下而上的合并策略bottom-up merging strategy：共享共同子目标的相邻细粒度步骤逐渐合并到更高级别的复合工具调用中，从而在不同工具粒度级别产生多个变体。: adjacent fine-grained steps sharing a common sub-goal are progressively merged into higher-level composite tool calls, yielding multiple variants at different levels of tool granularity.

交错 GUI 工具轨迹生成。Interleaved GUI-Tool Trajectory Generation.给定一个基于工具的轨迹，我们随机采样工具调用的子集，并将每个工具调用替换为原始轨迹中相应的 GUI 操作序列。 值得注意的是，被替换的工具同时从工具库中删除，构建了部分工具可用性上下文，当某些工具不可用时，代理必须回退到 GUI 操作。 通过改变替换工具调用的选择，我们从同一轨迹生成不同的交错变体，这些变体被聚合成Given a grounded tool-only trajectory, we randomly sample a subset of tool calls and replace each with its corresponding GUI action sequence from the original trajectory. Notably, the replaced tools are simultaneously removed from the tool library, constructing a partial tool-availability context where the agent must fall back to GUI operations when certain tools are unavailable. By varying the selection of replaced tool calls, we generate diverse interleaved variants from the same trajectory, which are aggregated into𝒟a​l​l\mathcal{D}_{all}。 代表性的交错 GUI 工具轨迹如图所示. A representative interleaved GUI-Tool trajectory is illustrated in Figure4。 此外，每次替换自然会暴露两种类型的边界转换： GUI. Furthermore, each replacement naturally exposes two types of boundary transitions: GUI→\rightarrow工具与工具Tool and Tool→\rightarrow图形用户界面（GUI (即i.e.，图中黄色星星, the yellow star in Figure3(a))，代理在 GUI 和工具调用之间切换。 我们将这些称为(a)), where the agent switches between GUI and tool calls. We refer to these as关键切换步骤critical switching steps并将它们收集到and collect them into𝒟c​r​i​t​i​c​a​l\mathcal{D}_{critical}.

2.3 工具引导的 GUI RFTTool-Bootstrapped GUI RFT

与With𝒟a​l​l\mathcal{D}_{all}和and𝒟c​r​i​t​i​c​a​l\mathcal{D}_{critical}，我们执行 Tool-Bootstrapped GUI RFT 来训练基线代理, we perform Tool-Bootstrapped GUI RFT to train the baseline agentℳb​a​s​e\mathcal{M}_{base}实现灵活的混合操作行为并校准本地 GUI 工具决策。toward flexible hybrid-action behavior and calibrate local GUI-Tool decisions.

预热监督微调（SFT）。Warmup Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).我们首先执行 SFTWe first perform SFT on𝒟a​l​l\mathcal{D}_{all}使用标准交叉熵损失using a standard cross-entropy lossℒS​F​T=−∑log⁡πθ​(at|st)\mathcal{L}_{SFT}=-\sum\log\pi_{\theta}(a_{t}|s_{t})。此阶段向模型传授 CUA 域中多模式工具调用的多种知识，例如工具使用、工具参数以及工具执行后的结果状态。经过这次 SFT 预热训练，我们得到了模型. This phase teaches the model the diverse knowledge of multimodal tool-calling in the CUA domain, like the tool usage, tool parameters, and the resulting state after tool executions. After this SFT warmup training, we get the modelℳs​f​t\mathcal{M}_{sft}

关键步骤上的单圈强化学习。Single-Turn RL on Critical Steps.建立在模型之上Building upon the modelℳs​f​t\mathcal{M}_{sft}，我们使用组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 算法实现单轮 RL 阶段, we implement a single-turn RL phase using the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm[shao2024deepseekmath] on 𝒟c​r​i​t​i​c​a​l\mathcal{D}_{critical}。通过对这些关键切换步骤的多次完成进行采样，模型会收到直接反馈，决定是继续执行 GUI 操作，还是在适当的工具可用时切换到工具调用。 这种有针对性的优化校准了模型在决策边界的辨别能力，从而产生了一个协调的智能体. By sampling multiple completions at these critical switching steps, the model receives direct feedback on whether to continue with GUI actions or switch to tool calls when appropriate tools are available. This targeted optimization calibrates the model’s discernment at decision boundaries, yielding a coordinated agentℳr​f​t\mathcal{M}_{rft}准备好在 GUI 工具环境中进行长期在线探索。ready for long-horizon online exploration in the GUI-Tool environment.

2.4 GUI 工具环境中具有工具高效路径奖励的在线代理强化学习Online Agentic RL with Tool-Efficient Path Reward in GUI-Tool Environment

在线强化学习将步骤级工具调用知识扩展到完整的轨迹，使代理能够通过真实环境探索发现哪些 GUI-工具切换策略可以带来成功的结果。 然而，仅凭任务成功并不能区分工具的使用是否真正合适，也不能区分执行路径是否不必要地长。 因此，我们引入一个Online RL extends step-level tool-calling knowledge to complete trajectories, enabling the agent to discover which GUI-Tool switching strategies lead to successful outcomes through real environment exploration. However, task success alone cannot distinguish whether tool usage was genuinely appropriate, nor whether the execution path was unnecessarily long. Therefore, we introduce a工具高效路径奖励Tool-Efficient Path Reward明确地将智能体塑造为适合工具且高效的轨迹， 它由工具适当性术语组成that explicitly shapes the agent toward tool-appropriate and efficient trajectories, which consists of a tool appropriateness termRt​o​o​lR_{tool}和路径效率项and path efficiency termRl​e​n​g​t​hR_{length}:

R=Rf​m​t+Ra​c​c+λ⋅Rt​o​o​l+β⋅Rl​e​n​g​t​h\begin{gathered}R=R_{fmt}+R_{acc}+\lambda\cdot R_{tool}+\beta\cdot R_{length}\\[5.0pt] \end{gathered} (2)

哪里whereRf​m​tR_{fmt}, Ra​c​cR_{acc}是标准格式和准确性奖励，并且are standard format and accuracy rewards, andRt​o​o​lR_{tool}, Rl​e​n​g​t​hR_{length}仅当轨迹成功时才激活。are activated only when the trajectory succeeds.

工具适当性奖励期限。Tool Appropriateness Reward Term.在实践中，即使工具有帮助，代理也可能在没有工具的情况下完成任务，或者在不需要工具的任务上不必要地调用工具。In practice, agents may complete a task without tools even when tools would help, or invoke tools unnecessarily on tasks that do not require them.Rt​o​o​lR_{tool}通过引入任务级工具有益标签来解决这个问题addresses this by introducing a task-level tool-beneficial labeltb∈{1,−1}t_{b}\in\{1,-1\}在数据构建过程中进行注释， 哪里annotated during data construction, wheretb=1t_{b}=1表明该任务有利于工具的使用，并且indicates that the task favors tool usage andtb=−1t_{b}=-1表示不需要使用工具。让indicates that tool usage is unnecessary. Letcc表示轨迹中工具调用的累积次数。denote the cumulative number of tool calls in a trajectory.

Rt​o​o​l=𝕀s​u​c​c⋅𝕀​[(tb>0∧c>0)∨(tb<0∧c=0)]\begin{gathered}R_{tool}=\mathbb{I}_{succ}\cdot\mathbb{I}[(t_{b}>0\land c>0)\lor(t_{b}<0\land c=0)]\\[2.0pt] \end{gathered} (3)

Rt​o​o​lR_{tool}当代理在工具有益的任务上调用工具时分配（is assigned when agents invoke tools on tool-beneficial tasks (tb=1,c>0t_{b}=1,c>0），或者当它故意放弃使用工具来完成对工具无益的任务时（), or when it deliberately abstains from tools on non-tool-beneficial tasks (tb=−1,c=0t_{b}=-1,c=0）。 这种设计将工具的使用与任务的成功脱钩，促使代理在且仅在真正需要时才使用工具。). This design decouples tool usage from task success, pushing the agent to use tools when and only when they are truly needed.

路径效率奖励期限。Path Efficiency Reward Term.即使代理成功并适当地使用了工具，它仍然可能会采取不必要的长路径。 例如，当单个工具调用可以实现相同的效果时，依赖冗余的 GUI 操作。 为此，Even when the agent succeeds and uses tools appropriately, it may still take unnecessarily long paths. For example, relying on redundant GUI operations when a single tool call could accomplish the same effect. To this end,Rl​e​n​g​t​hR_{length}鼓励智能体通过在线交互积极探索和发现更高效的GUI工具执行路径。 我们不是根据固定阈值来衡量效率，而是评估相对于推出组的轨迹长度， 哪里encourages the agent to actively explore and discover more efficient GUI-Tool execution paths through online interaction. Rather than measuring efficiency against a fixed threshold, we evaluate trajectory length relative to the rollout group, wheress是当前轨迹的步数，is the current trajectory’s step count,,s¯\bar{s}是组平均步长，并且is the group average step length, andSm​a​xS_{max}是最大执行范围。is the maximum execution horizon.

Rl​e​n​g​t​h=𝕀s​u​c​c⋅{(1+s¯−ss¯)s<s¯exp⁡(−s−s¯Sm​a​x−s¯)s≥s¯\begin{gathered}R_{length}=\mathbb{I}_{succ}\cdot\begin{cases}(1+\frac{\bar{s}-s}{\bar{s}})&s<\bar{s}\\ \exp(-\frac{s-\bar{s}}{S_{max}-\bar{s}})&s\geq\bar{s}\end{cases}\end{gathered} (4)

对于短于群体平均值的轨迹，智能体将获得与相对步数减少成正比的线性奖励；否则，随着轨迹变长，奖励会呈指数衰减。 由于有用的工具调用通常会取代多个原子 GUI 操作，因此当工具导致更短、更可靠的执行路径时，此信号自然会激励代理切换到工具。For trajectories shorter than the group average, the agent receives a linear bonus proportional to the relative step reduction; otherwise, the reward decays exponentially as the trajectory grows longer. Since useful tool calls often replace multiple atomic GUI operations, this signal naturally incentivizes the agent to switch to tools when they lead to a shorter and more reliable execution path.

有了上述奖励，我们在 GUI 工具环境中使用多轮 GRPO 在线部署来优化 ToolCUA。 灵感来自 DAPOWith the above reward, we optimize ToolCUA using multi-turn GRPO over online rollouts in a GUI-Tool environment. Inspired by DAPO[yu2025dapo]，我们应用动态过滤并仅保留包含成功和失败轨迹的 rollout 组，这提高了组相关策略更新的信息量，同时减少了不必要的计算。, we apply dynamic filtering and retain only rollout groups containing both successful and failed trajectories, which improves the informativeness of group-relative policy updates while reducing unnecessary computation.

3.2 主要结果Main Results

GUI 工具执行路径选择方面具有出色的性能。Outstanding performance on GUI-Tool Execution Path Selection.表Table2总结了 OSWorld-MCP 基准测试的评估结果，其中 ToolCUA-8B 在 8B 级模型中实现了 46.85% 的 SOTA 性能。 我们的模型超越了之前最先进的 GUI-Owl-1.5-8B (43.84%)，并优于著名的通用基础模型，包括 Gemini-3.1-Pro (41.14%) 和 Claude-4-Sonnet (43.54%)，同时落后于顶级 claude-4.5-sonnet 不到 2%。 与基线 (28.23%) 相比大约有 66% 的相对改进强调了我们的综合驱动的扩展管道和分阶段训练范例的有效性。 除了任务准确性之外，ToolCUA 还大大提高了 GUI-Tool 编排和执行效率。如表所示summarizes the evaluation results on the OSWorld-MCP benchmark, where ToolCUA-8B achieves a SOTA performance of 46.85% among 8B-class models. Our model surpasses the previous state-of-the-art GUI-Owl-1.5-8B (43.84%) and outperforms prominent general foundation models, including Gemini-3.1-Pro (41.14%) and Claude-4-Sonnet (43.54%), while trailing the top-tier claude-4.5-sonnet by less than 2%. This approximately 66% relative improvement over the baseline (28.23%) underscores the efficacy of our synthesis-driven scaling pipeline and staged training paradigm. Beyond task accuracy, ToolCUA also substantially improves GUI-Tool orchestration and execution efficiency. As shown in Table1与纯 GUI 设置相比，ToolCUA-8B 表现出 +3.9% 的改进。 此外，与 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 基线相比，ToolCUA 将整体 TIR 从 8.41% 提高到 24.32%，同时将 ACS 从 19.34 降低到 14.93。 值得注意的是，ToolCUA 在所有评估的模型中实现了最低的平均完成步骤（14.93 步），这表明它不仅完成了更多任务，而且还通过我们的工具高效路径奖励智能地找到了更高效的 GUI 工具执行路径。, ToolCUA-8B demonstrates a +3.9% improvement compared with pure GUI settings. Also, compared with the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, ToolCUA increases the overall TIR from 8.41% to 24.32%, while reducing ACS from 19.34 to 14.93. Notably, ToolCUA achieves the lowest average completion steps (14.93 steps) among all evaluated models, indicating that it not only completes more tasks but also intelligently finds more efficient GUI-Tool execution paths with our Tool-Efficient Path Reward.

3.3 消融分析Ablation Analysis

交错 GUI 工具轨迹数据的重要性。The Importance of the Interleaved GUI-Tool Trajectory Data.如图中“w/o Interleaved data”设置所示As shown by the “w/o Interleaved data” setting in Figure6，我们使用合成的交错 GUI 工具数据删除冷启动 RFT 训练，并直接将具有工具高效路径奖励的在线代理 RL 应用到 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 基线模型。 尽管该模型在代理强化学习期间仍然提高了其整体任务准确性，但在没有轨迹缩放管道产生的离线交错监督的情况下，它很难获得可靠的工具调用行为。 具体来说，其 TIR 始终保持较低水平，在训练结束时仅达到 15% 左右，而在大部分学习过程中工具调用次数始终接近于零。 这表明仅具有工具效率奖励的在线强化学习不足以克服基础模型以 GUI 为中心的偏见。 相反，我们的数据扩展管道将模拟工具合成到静态 GUI 数据中，以提供接地、交错的监督。这灌输了多样化的工具知识和切换先验，为后续的在线探索奠定了良好的基础。, we remove coldstart RFT training with our synthetic interleaved GUI-Tool data and directly apply online agentic RL with the tool-efficient path reward to the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline model. Although the model still improves its overall task accuracy during agentic RL, it struggles to acquire reliable tool-calling behavior without the offline interleaved supervision produced by our trajectory scaling pipeline. Specifically, its TIR remains consistently low and only reaches around 15% by the end of training, while the number of tool calls stays close to zero throughout most of the learning process. This suggests that online RL with tool-efficiency rewards alone is insufficient to overcome the GUI-centric bias of base models. Instead, our data scaling pipeline synthesizes simulated tools into static GUI data to provide grounded, interleaved supervision. This instills diverse tool knowledge and switching priors, establishing a superior foundation for subsequent online exploration.

工具高效路径奖励的优点。Advantages of Tool-Efficient Path Reward.如图中“无我们的路径奖励”设置所示As illustrated by the “w/o Our path reward” setting in Figure6，我们仅使用标准的多轮 GRPO 进一步训练 RFT 初始化模型, we further train the RFT-initialized model with vanilla multi-turn GRPO, using only the standardRa​c​cR_{acc}和andRf​m​tR_{fmt}奖励。 如果没有适合工具和轨迹长度的奖励，准确率曲线会变得不如 ToolCUA 稳定，在第 8-11 步周围出现明显下降，并在 20 个训练步骤后最终差距约为 7 个百分点。 此外，TIR 和工具调用都会波动，没有一致的上升趋势，这表明模型在工具调用真正有益时不会学习。 轨迹长度也缺乏稳定的下降趋势，并在暂时减少后反弹，这表明普通代理强化学习无法可靠地发现更有效的执行路径。 这些结果验证了工具高效路径奖励对于将在线探索转变为适合工具且具有效率意识的 GUI 工具路径选择至关重要。rewards. Without the tool-appropriate and trajectory-length reward, the accuracy curve becomes less stable than ToolCUA, showing a clear drop around steps 8–11 and an eventual gap of about 7 percentage points after 20 training steps. Moreover, both TIR and tool-calls fluctuate without a consistent upward trend, suggesting that the model does not learn when tool invocation is genuinely beneficial. The trajectory length also lacks a stable downward trend and rebounds after temporary decreases, indicating that vanilla agentic RL does not reliably discover more efficient execution paths. These results validate that the Tool-Efficient Path Reward is essential for turning online exploration into tool-appropriate and efficiency-aware GUI-Tool path selection.

混合 GUI 工具培训比纯 GUI 更有效。Hybrid GUI-Tool Training is More Effective than pure GUI.我们将混合 GUI-工具训练与表中的纯 GUI 训练管道进行了比较We compare hybrid GUI-Tool training with a pure GUI training pipeline in Table4。 对于纯 GUI 设置，我们首先使用与 ToolCUA 的预热数据规模相当的纯 GUI 数据集冷启动基线，然后完全在纯 GUI 操作空间内进行代理强化学习。 尽管纯 GUI 训练在 SFT 后将基线从 29.03% 提高到 34.93%，在代理 RL 后进一步提高到 42.05%，但这两个阶段仍然低于 GUI 工具对应的阶段。 相比之下，使用我们的合成交错 GUI 工具轨迹进行的 RFT 训练已经达到 38.13%，在线代理 RL 后，完整的 ToolCUA 进一步提高到 46.85%。 这些结果表明，混合 GUI-工具操作空间提供了比纯 GUI 操作更有效的训练环境，使代理不仅能够学习视觉基础，而且还能学习结构化工具调用何时可以取代冗余的低级操作。. For the pure GUI setting, we first cold-start the baseline using a GUI-only dataset of comparable scale to ToolCUA’s warmup data, and then conduct agentic RL entirely within the pure GUI action space. Although GUI-only training improves the baseline from 29.03% to 34.93% after SFT and further to 42.05% after agentic RL, both stages remain below their GUI-Tool counterparts. In comparison, RFT training with our synthetic interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories already reaches 38.13%, and the full ToolCUA further improves to 46.85% after online agentic RL. These results indicate that the hybrid GUI-Tool action space provides a more effective training environment than pure GUI actions, enabling the agent to learn not only visual grounding but also when structured tool calls can replace redundant low-level operations.

4 相关工作Related Work

用于计算机使用的多模式代理。Multimodal Agents for Computer Use.在数字环境中构建通用多模式代理长期以来一直是一项基础但具有挑战性的追求Building generalist multimodal agents in digital environments has long been a foundational yet challenging pursuit[bai2025qwen3, openai2025operator, anthropic2025claudeopus45, xie2024osworld, wang2025opencua, wang2025mobile, ye2025mobilev3, qin2025ui]。 当前的 CUA 通常遵循两种范式： 多智能体系统. Current CUAs generally follow two paradigms: multi-agent systems[agashe2025agent, song2025coact, gonzalez2025unreasonable_agents3, liu2025pc, yang2025gta1, yang2026symphony]，跨专业模块和端到端代理模型分解任务, which decompose tasks across specialized modules, and end-to-end agentic models[qin2025ui, wang2025opencua, liu2025scalecua, xue2026evocua, xu2026mobilev35]，将规划和基础整合到统一的政策中。 然而，大多数这些代理仍然主要依赖于原始的 GUI 操作，例如单击、键入和滚动，使得长期任务容易出现级联错误和执行效率低下。 因此，强化学习被引入来改进 GUI 代理，从移动导航设置, which integrate planning and grounding within a unified policy. Most of these agents, however, still rely primarily on primitive GUI actions such as clicking, typing, and scrolling, making long-horizon tasks vulnerable to cascading errors and inefficient execution. Reinforcement learning has therefore been introduced to improve GUI agents, from mobile navigation settings[lu2025uir1, luo2025guir1]更广泛的代理 GUI 环境to broader agentic GUI environments[xu2025mobilerl, yang2025zerogui, lu2025arpo, li2025dartgui, wang2026rlanything]。 这些研究证明了环境驱动优化的前景，但它们的操作空间很大程度上局限于 GUI 操作，并且通常为轨迹级编排提供有限的监督。 因此，它们并不直接解决将原始 GUI 交互与现实计算机使用环境中的结构化工具调用相结合的混合操作空间. These studies demonstrate the promise of environment-driven optimization, but their action spaces are largely restricted to GUI operations and often provide limited supervision for trajectory-level orchestration. Consequently, they do not directly address the hybrid action spaces that combine raw GUI interaction with structured tool invocation in realistic computer-use environments[ye2026claw, openclaw2025]。 ToolCUA 在此方向上构建，通过使用分阶段训练范例来超越仅 GUI 控制并优化完整的 GUI 工具执行路径。. ToolCUA builds on this direction by using a staged training paradigm to move beyond GUI-only control and optimize complete GUI-Tool execution paths.

CUA 的混合 GUI 工具操作。Hybrid GUI-Tool Actions for CUAs.广泛的研究为法学硕士提供了工具A broad line of research equips LLMs with tools[qin2023toolllm, patil2023gorilla]，推动自主编码取得进展, enabling progress in autonomous coding[dong2025tool, feng2025retool, wang2025acting],深入研究, deep research[team2025tongyi, ye2025agentfold]和多模态视觉搜索, and multimodal visual search[su2025thinking, zheng2025deepeyes, hong2025deepeyesv2, liu2025visual, wang2025adatooler]。 在CUA场景中，在有可靠的接口的情况下，结构化工具可以减少重复的底层GUI操作，提高效率。 最近的研究. In CUA scenarios, structured tools can reduce repetitive low-level GUI operations and improve efficiency when reliable interfaces are available. Recent studies[yan2025mcpworld, jia2025osworldmcp]已经开始对此进行探索，引入了用于混合动作评估的各种 MCP 工具，同时几个 GUI 工具系统have begun to explore this, which introduce various MCP tools for hybrid-action evaluation, while several GUI-tool systems[yan2025step, wang2025ui, yang2025ultracua, song2025coact, gonzalez2025unreasonable_agents3, yang2026symphony]将 GUI 代理与 API、SDK、外部执行器或多代理工具路由器连接。 然而，这些努力仍然未能解决两个关键挑战。 首先，高质量的交错 GUI 工具轨迹仍然稀缺，因为现有的管道通常依赖于昂贵的工具构建、环境或闭源数据收集。 其次，现有方法为轨迹级别选择提供的指导有限。 ToolCUA 通过综合交错的 GUI 工具轨迹和两阶段训练范例来解决这些限制。connect GUI agents with APIs, SDKs, external executors, or multi-agent tool routers. Nevertheless, these efforts still fail to solve two critical challenges. First, high-quality interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories remain scarce because existing pipelines often rely on costly tool construction, environment, or closed-source data collection. Second, existing methods provide limited guidance for trajectory-level selection. ToolCUA addresses these limitations by synthesizing interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories and a two-staged training paradigm.

5 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们提出了In this work, we presented工具CUAToolCUA，一个端到端计算机使用代理，用于编排 GUI 和工具操作，学习最佳的 GUI 工具路径选择。 我们表明，仅仅将代理暴露给 GUI 操作和工具调用是不够的，因为当前模型经常过度使用工具或仍然过度以 GUI 为中心，导致低效且脆弱的执行轨迹。 为了应对这一挑战，ToolCUA 首先从现有 GUI 数据中扩展交错的 GUI-工具轨迹，而无需手动构建工具，然后应用工具引导的 GUI RFT 来获取工具调用知识并校准关键切换决策。 最后，具有工具高效路径奖励的在线代理强化学习在 GUI 工具环境中优化了 ToolCUA，鼓励适当的工具使用和更短的执行路径。 OSWorld-MCP 上的实验表明，ToolCUA 的准确率达到了 46.85%，比基线相对提高了约 66%，并且比纯 GUI 操作设置持续改进。 连同传输结果和消融研究，这些发现表明，使用混合 GUI 工具动作空间进行训练为强大的现实世界数字代理提供了高保真度训练范例。, an end-to-end computer use agent for orchestrating GUI and Tool actions, learning an optimal GUI-Tool path selection. We show that simply exposing agents to both GUI actions and tool calls is insufficient, as current models often overuse tools or remain overly GUI-centric, leading to inefficient and brittle execution trajectories. To address this challenge, ToolCUA first scales interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories from existing GUI data without manually constructing tools, then applies Tool-Bootstrapped GUI RFT to acquire tool-calling knowledge and calibrate critical switching decisions. Finally, Online Agentic RL with a Tool-Efficient Path Reward optimizes ToolCUA in a GUI-Tool environment, encouraging appropriate tool use and shorter execution paths. Experiments on OSWorld-MCP show that ToolCUA achieves 46.85% accuracy, a relative improvement of approximately 66% over the baseline, and consistently improves over pure GUI action settings. Together with the transfer results and ablation study, these findings suggest that training with a hybrid GUI-Tool action space provides a high-fidelity training paradigm for robust real-world digital agents.

A 局限性和未来的工作Limitations and Future Works

尽管 ToolCUA 展示了从合成的交错 GUI 工具轨迹中学习的有效性，但我们的合成驱动管道仍然受到原始 GUI 轨迹的状态框架和域覆盖范围的限制。因此，合成混合轨迹的多样性和质量与源演示的广度、保真度和任务分布相结合。我们的工具扩展过程还取决于用于综合的通用模型的能力；在我们的内部试验中，用 Qwen3.5-Plus 替换更强的专有模型会导致发电效率和轨迹质量明显降低。 此外，综合工具不依赖于特定的具体实现，这使得它们具有可扩展性并且可能更具通用性，但也意味着现实世界的执行仍然取决于可用工具的成熟度以及为 CUA 组织工具反馈的方式。 最后，由于计算机使用代理的开源 GUI 工具协调基准的稀缺，我们的主要性能评估主要在 OSWorld-MCP 上进行，从而使更广泛的基准覆盖范围成为一个重要的限制。Although ToolCUA demonstrates the effectiveness of learning from synthesized interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories, our synthesis-driven pipeline is still constrained by the state frames and domain coverage of the original GUI-only trajectories. As a result, the diversity and quality of the synthesized hybrid trajectories are coupled with the breadth, fidelity, and task distribution of the source demonstrations. Our tool-scaling process also depends on the capability of the general model used for synthesis; in our internal trials, replacing stronger proprietary models with Qwen3.5-Plus led to noticeably lower generation efficiency and trajectory quality. Moreover, the synthesized tools are not tied to a specific concrete implementation, which makes them scalable and potentially more generalizable, but also means that real-world execution still depends on the maturity of available tools and the way tool feedback is organized for the CUA. Finally, due to the scarcity of open-source GUI-Tool coordination benchmarks for computer-use agents, our main performance evaluation is primarily conducted on OSWorld-MCP, leaving broader benchmark coverage as an important limitation.

未来的工作应该进一步探索跨更广泛平台的混合 GUI-工具操作空间，包括桌面、移动和 Web 环境，其中原子 GUI 操作和高级工具之间的平衡可能因界面结构和任务类型的不同而有很大差异。 另一个有前景的方向是通过混合 GUI-工具操作构建更轻、更多样化、更强大的环境，从而减少代理强化学习对重型沙箱基础设施的依赖。 我们还对能够解耦训练和推理时间推出的异步强化学习框架感兴趣，这可能会提高计算机使用代理的长期策略优化的可扩展性和稳定性。Future work should further explore hybrid GUI-Tool action spaces across broader platforms, including desktop, mobile, and web environments, where the balance between atomic GUI operations and high-level tools may vary substantially across interface structures and task types. Another promising direction is to reduce the dependence of agentic RL on heavy sandbox infrastructure by building lighter, more diverse, and more robust environments with hybrid GUI-Tool actions. We are also interested in asynchronous RL frameworks that decouple training and inference-time rollout, which may improve the scalability and stability of long-horizon policy optimization for computer-use agents.

B 更广泛的影响和道德声明Broader Impact and Ethics Statement

ToolCUA 旨在通过使计算机使用代理能够更有效地协调 GUI 操作和工具调用来改进现实世界的数字自动化，这可能有利于生产力、可访问性和重复工作流程协助。与此同时，功能更强大的 CUA 也会带来潜在风险，包括未经授权的操作、用户数据的意外修改、桌面观察的隐私泄露以及滥用自动化有害或欺骗性在线活动。我们的工作重点是基准沙箱环境，不会授予代理对个人帐户、敏感文件或外部服务的不受控制的访问权限。对于现实世界的部署，我们认为此类系统应该需要明确的用户同意、透明的操作日志记录、权限边界以及对高影响力操作的人工确认。ToolCUA aims to improve real-world digital automation by enabling computer-use agents to coordinate GUI actions and tool calls more efficiently, which may benefit productivity, accessibility, and repetitive workflow assistance. At the same time, more capable CUAs introduce potential risks, including unauthorized operation, accidental modification of user data, privacy leakage from desktop observations, and misuse for automating harmful or deceptive online activities. Our work focuses on benchmarked sandbox environments and does not grant the agent uncontrolled access to personal accounts, sensitive files, or external services. For real-world deployment, we believe such systems should require explicit user consent, transparent action logging, permission boundaries, and human confirmation for high-impact operations.

ACS reports the average completion trajectory steps, reflecting execution efficiency, and Tool-Calls reports the average number of tool calls.

实验设置。Experimental Settings.对于表中报告的结果For the results reported in Table1，我们遵循与两个动作空间设置相对应的两个评估协议。对于仅 GUI 设置，我们直接使用官方 OSWorld 发布的经过验证的轨迹, we follow two evaluation protocols corresponding to the two action-space settings. For Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct and Qwen3VL-235B-A22B-Thinking, we conduct the evaluation ourselves, aligned with the official implementations. For clarity, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct is abbreviated as Qwen3VL-8B, and Qwen3VL-235B-A22B-Thinking is abbreviated as Qwen3VL-235B throughout Table1。 对于“GUI+工具”设置，我们直接在OSWorld-MCP上评估相同的模型，确保与官方提示和消息构造协议的一致性。我们还使用相同的 50 个步骤的最大范围，并仅报告可行任务子集的结果。 请参阅附录中的更多指标详细信息. We also use the same maximum horizon of 50 steps and report results only on the feasible task subset. See more metric details in AppendixC.4.

结果见表The results in Table1揭示了一个反直觉的发现：简单地为强大的模型提供对 GUI 操作和工具的访问并不能可靠地提高性能。相反，混合行动空间通常reveal a counter-intuitive finding: simply giving a strong model access to both GUI actions and tools does not reliably improve performance. Instead, the hybrid action space often混淆confuses代理，导致其偏离最有效的执行路径。 更具体地说，表the agent, causing it to deviate from the most effective execution path. More concretely, Table1揭示了两种具有代表性的故障模式，与图所示的直觉一致exposes two representative failure modes that align with the intuition illustrated in Figure2：一旦两个行动空间都可用，代理人就会站在“岔路”上，常常无法选择正确的分支。: once both action spaces are available, the agent stands at a “forked road” and often fails to choose the right branch.

故障模式一：工具使用不足。Failure Mode I: tool underuse.即使可以使用简短的工具调用，某些模型仍然过度以 GUI 为中心。 Qwen3VL-8B是最明显的例子：引入工具后，它平均每个轨迹仅调用0.00次工具，这表明它几乎从未离开GUI分支。 然而这种保守的行为并没有保持性能：它的准确率从 29.0% 下降到 28.2%，而 ACS 也从 19.2 略有上升到 19.3。 这表明该模型无法识别决策边界，而切换到结构化工具会缩短路径并减少累积的 GUI 错误。Some models remain overly GUI-centric even when a short tool call is available. Qwen3VL-8B is the clearest example: after tools are introduced, it invokes tools only 0.00 times per trajectory on average, which indicates that it almost never leaves the GUI branch. Yet this conservative behavior does not preserve performance: its accuracy drops from 29.0% to 28.2%, while ACS also slightly increases from 19.2 to 19.3. This suggests that the model is unable to recognize the decision boundary where switching to a structured tool would shorten the path and reduce accumulated GUI errors.

故障模式二：工具过度使用。Failure Mode II: tool overuse.在另一个极端，更强或更大的模型可能会积极地调用工具，但仅频繁使用工具并不能转化为更好的任务完成。 例如，Qwen3VL-235B 将其平均工具调用次数增加到 6.10，但准确率从 41.1% 下降到 38.1%。 尽管其完成步骤从 25.9 减少到 17.4，但较短的轨迹并不会带来更好的任务成功率。 EvoCUA-32B 显示了类似的趋势，平均调用工具 7.49 次，但准确率大幅下降 12.0%。 它的步数甚至从 25.0 增加到 26.1，这表明当切换策略不佳时，工具访问会同时损害有效性和效率。 Claude 基线从另一个角度也表现出同样的现象：Claude-4-sonnet 将步数从 23.6 减少到 19.2，平均调用工具次数为 4.50 次；而 Claude-4.5-sonnet 将步数从 23.3 减少到 19.1，平均调用工具次数为 3.90 次，但它们的准确率仍然分别下降了 4.2% 和 13.5%。 这些案例表明，智能体并不是在学习“更多地使用工具”，而是需要学习At the other extreme, stronger or larger models may invoke tools aggressively, but frequent tool usage alone does not translate into better task completion. For example, Qwen3VL-235B increases its average Tool-Calls to 6.10, yet its accuracy drops from 41.1% to 38.1%. Although its completion steps decrease from 25.9 to 17.4, the shorter trajectory does not lead to better task success. EvoCUA-32B shows a similar tendency, invoking tools 7.49 times on average while suffering a substantial 12.0% accuracy drop. Its steps even increases from 25.0 to 26.1, showing that tool access can simultaneously hurt both effectiveness and efficiency when the switching policy is poor. The Claude baselines exhibit the same phenomenon from another angle: Claude-4-sonnet reduces steps from 23.6 to 19.2 and invokes tools 4.50 times on average, while Claude-4.5-sonnet reduces steps from 23.3 to 19.1 and invokes tools 3.90 times on average, yet their accuracies still regress by 4.2% and 13.5%, respectively. These cases indicate that the agent is not learning “use tools more,” but rather needs to learn当when工具使用得当。 过度切换可能会过早地放弃必要的 GUI 基础，在建立所需的上下文之前调用工具，或者将轨迹提交到较短但不太可靠的脆弱的工具密集型路径。tool usage is appropriate. Over-switching can prematurely abandon necessary GUI grounding, call tools before the required context is established, or commit the trajectory to a brittle tool-heavy path that is shorter but less reliable.

综合起来，表Taken together, Table1表明混合 GUI-工具代理的核心挑战是最佳 GUI-工具路径选择，而不是原始操作空间扩展。 问题不在于模型是否可以识别工具的存在，而在于它是否可以确定当前状态是否需要继续 GUI 基础、立即调用工具或在附加 GUI 设置后稍后切换。 换句话说，混合执行引入了轨迹级决策问题：局部合理的动作仍可能导致全局较差的路径。 这正是图抽象出来的混乱demonstrates that the core challenge of hybrid GUI-Tool agents is optimal GUI-Tool path selection rather than raw action-space expansion. The issue is not whether the model can recognize that a tool exists, but whether it can determine if the current state calls for continued GUI grounding, an immediate tool invocation, or a later switch after additional GUI setup. In other words, hybrid execution introduces a trajectory-level decision problem: a locally plausible action may still lead to a globally inferior path. This is exactly the confusion abstracted by Figure2，代理必须在 GUI 路径和工具路径之间进行选择，而没有可靠的内部策略来决定哪条路径实际上更好。 相比之下，ToolCUA是表中唯一的模型, where the agent must choose between the GUI path and the tool path without a reliable internal policy for deciding which route is actually better. In contrast, ToolCUA is the only model in Table1受益于混合操作空间：其准确度从 42.9% 提高到 46.8%，而 ACS 从 19.4 下降到 14.9，平均工具调用次数仅为 0.74。 这一结果表明，有效的混合执行不需要过度使用工具，而是需要选择性切换策略，仅在轨迹上的有益点调用工具。 因此，这些初步结果激发了我们的训练范式：ToolCUA 旨在从交错监督和轨迹级强化中内化最佳 GUI-工具路径选择，而不是依靠零样本提示自行解决分叉问题。that benefits from the hybrid action space: its accuracy improves from 42.9% to 46.8%, while ACS drops from 19.4 to 14.9 with only 0.74 average Tool-Calls. This result suggests that effective hybrid execution does not require excessive tool usage, but a selective switching policy that calls tools only at beneficial points along the trajectory. Therefore, these preliminary results motivate our training paradigm: ToolCUA is designed to internalize optimal GUI-Tool path selection from interleaved supervision and trajectory-level reinforcement, rather than relying on zero-shot prompting to resolve the fork on its own.

C.4 基准评估Benchmark Evaluation

我们主要在 OSWorld-MCP 上评估 ToolCUAWe evaluate ToolCUA primarily on OSWorld-MCP[jia2025osworldmcp]，它通过工具操作扩展了 OSWorld，因此可以直接测量混合 GUI 工具的执行情况。按照基准协议，我们报告三个指标：任务准确性、工具调用率 (TIR) 和平均完成步骤 (ACS)。为了减少沙箱随机性，我们报告 OSWorld-MCP 的平均@3 结果，并将每个任务的最大执行步骤数设置为 50。, which extends OSWorld with tool actions and therefore directly measures hybrid GUI-Tool execution. Following the benchmark protocol, we report three metrics: task accuracy, Tool Invocation Rate (TIR), and Average Completion Steps (ACS). To reduce sandbox stochasticity, we report average@3 results for OSWorld-MCP and set the maximum number of execution steps to 50 for each task.

任务准确性。Task Accuracy.任务准确性是主要的成功指标，衡量智能体是否根据基准评估器完成目标指令。在OSWorld-MCP中，这个指标不仅反映了视觉基础和GUI交互能力，还反映了智能体是否可以使用提供的工具达到正确的最终状态。Task accuracy is the primary success metric and measures whether an agent completes the target instruction according to the benchmark evaluator. In OSWorld-MCP, this metric reflects not only visual grounding and GUI interaction ability, but also whether the agent can use the provided tools to reach the correct final state.

工具调用率 (TIR)。Tool Invocation Rate (TIR).OSWorld-MCP 进一步将任务分为对工具有益的任务和对工具无益的任务，使我们能够衡量代理是否在适当的上下文中调用工具，而不仅仅是更频繁地调用工具。让OSWorld-MCP further separates tasks into Tool-Beneficial Tasks and Non-Tool-Beneficial Tasks, allowing us to measure whether an agent invokes tools in appropriate contexts rather than merely calling tools more often. LetNtN_{t}是对工具有益的任务总数，并且be the total number of Tool-Beneficial Tasks, andntn_{t}代理在评估期间调用工具并成功完成任务的此类任务的数量。让the number of such tasks in which the agent invoked a tool and successfully completed the task during evaluation. LetNgN_{g}是对工具无益的任务总数，并且be the total number of Non-Tool-Beneficial Tasks, andngn_{g}代理未调用工具并成功完成任务的此类任务的数量。我们将 TIR 定义为：the number of such tasks in which the agent did not invoke a tool and successfully completed the task. We define TIR as:

TIR=(nt+ng)/(Nt+Ng)\textrm{TIR}={(n_{t}+n_{g})}/{(N_{t}+N_{g})} (5)

因此，TIR 捕获代理是否将其工具使用与任务级工具实用性保持一致，包括在有益时使用工具以及在 GUI 操作更合适时避免使用工具。TIR therefore captures whether the agent aligns its tool usage with task-level tool utility, including both using tools when they are beneficial and avoiding them when GUI actions are more appropriate.

平均完成步骤 (ACS)。Average Completion Steps (ACS).ACS 测量代理跨任务使用的环境交互步骤的平均数量。对于ACS measures the average number of environment interaction steps used by an agent across tasks. ForNN任务，如果任务的执行步骤数tasks, if the number of execution steps for taskii is SiS_{i}，平均完成步骤计算如下：, the Average Completion Steps is computed as:

ACS=∑i=1NSi/N\textrm{ACS}={\sum_{i=1}^{N}{S_{i}}}/{N} (6)

ACS 反映了执行效率：识别较短的工具条件路径并避免冗余 GUI 操作的代理通常需要更少的步骤来完成相同的任务。ACS reflects execution efficiency: agents that identify shorter tool-conditioned paths and avoid redundant GUI operations generally require fewer steps to complete the same task.

为了评估跨平台传输，我们还在WindowsAgentArena上评估了ToolCUATo assess cross-platform transfer, we also evaluate ToolCUA on WindowsAgentArena[bonatti2024windows]。我们设定. We set最大步数max_steps每个任务 =50 并报告 Accuracy@avg3 值作为主要指标。=50 for each task and report the accuracy@avg3 value as the main metric.

C.5 消融细节Ablation Details

我们进行了三项消融研究，以分析每个训练组件的贡献以及混合 GUI-工具操作空间的效果。前两项研究，如图We conduct three ablation studies to analyze the contribution of each training component and the effect of the hybrid GUI-Tool action space. The first two studies, shown in Figure6，检验我们分阶段培训设计的有效性。在第一个设置中，表示为“无交错数据”，我们删除了离线交错 GUI 工具数据引导阶段，并直接将在线代理强化学习与建议的工具高效路径奖励应用于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 基线。此设置测试仅在线探索是否可以从稀疏轨迹级反馈中获取工具调用知识和 GUI-工具切换能力。在第二种设置中，模型首先使用工具引导的 GUI RFT 进行初始化，然后使用基于普通 GRPO 的代理 RL 目标进行优化，该目标仅使用标准精度奖励, examine the effectiveness of our staged training design. In the first setting, denoted as “w/o Interleaved data”, we remove the offline interleaved GUI-Tool data bootstrapping stage and directly apply online agentic RL with the proposed Tool-Efficient Path Reward to the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline. This setting tests whether online exploration alone can acquire tool-calling knowledge and GUI-Tool switching ability from sparse trajectory-level feedback. In the second setting, the model is first initialized with Tool-Bootstrapped GUI RFT, and then optimized with a vanilla GRPO-based agentic RL objective that only uses the standard accuracy rewardRa​c​cR_{acc}和格式奖励and format rewardRf​m​tR_{fmt}。该变体删除了工具适当性奖励项和路径效率奖励项，在模型已经获得了基本的工具调用知识和本地切换能力后，隔离了工具高效路径奖励的效果。. This variant removes the Tool Appropriateness Reward Term and Path Efficiency Reward Term, isolating the effect of the Tool-Efficient Path Reward after the model has already acquired basic tool-calling knowledge and local switching capability.

第三次消融，报告于表中The third ablation, reported in Table4，将混合 GUI-工具操作空间中的训练与纯 GUI 操作空间中的训练进行比较。对于纯 GUI 设置，我们使用与预热 SFT 数据规模相当的纯 GUI 数据集对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 基线进行微调，然后在纯 GUI 操作空间中执行在线代理 RL。由于工具操作在此环境中不可用，因此奖励仅包括, compares training in the hybrid GUI-Tool action space with training in a pure GUI action space. For the pure-GUI setting, we fine-tune the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline using a GUI-only dataset of comparable scale to the warmup SFT data, and then perform online agentic RL within the pure GUI action space. Since tool actions are unavailable in this environment, the reward consists only ofRa​c​c+Rf​m​t+Rl​e​n​g​t​hR_{acc}+R_{fmt}+R_{length}，其中路径效率奖励条款仍然鼓励高效执行，但不能奖励适合工具的决策。最终评估也是在纯 GUI 操作空间下进行的，使我们能够直接比较混合 GUI-工具训练是否比纯 GUI 训练提供了更高保真度的优化设置。, where the Path Efficiency Reward Term still encourages efficient execution but cannot reward tool-appropriate decisions. The final evaluation is also conducted under the pure GUI action space, allowing us to directly compare whether hybrid GUI-Tool training provides a higher-fidelity optimization setting than GUI-only training.

对于所有在线代理 RL 消融，我们遵循第 1 节中的评估协议For all online agentic RL ablations, we follow the evaluation protocol in SectionC.4并报告平均@3 结果。训练期间的最大推出范围设置为and report average@3 results. Each run consumes approximately8×88\times 8GPU 与分布式 ECS 沙箱工作人员一起工作大约六天。GPUs together with distributed ECS sandbox workers for about six days.

D 更多案例研究More Case Study

分析：Analysis:本案例研究 LibreOffice Calc 任务，其中的指令是在名为 Sheet2 的新工作表中创建两个数据透视表，显示按产品和销售渠道划分的总收入。工具调用通过让代理直接与 Calc 交互、检查来提供帮助 工作簿元数据，读取工作表内容，并直接从环境信息中调用“create_pivot_table”。This case studies a LibreOffice Calc task where the instruction is to create two pivot tables in a new sheet named Sheet2, showing total revenue by product and by sales channel. Tool calling helps by letting the agent interact directly with Calc, inspect workbook metadata, read sheet content, and directly call create_pivot_table” from the env info.

分析：Analysis:

本案例主要演示了一个 VS Code 工作区管理任务：“将 /home/user/data1 和 /home/user/data2 添加到当前工作区”。在执行过程中，代理首先直接调用工具功能“addfolder”将两个文件夹中的每一个添加到当前 VS Code 窗口。此步骤突出了处理结构化编辑任务时工具调用的效率和确定性。 随后，虽然通过工具调用已经完成了核心目标，但 VS Code 却提示“你信任作者吗？”信任确认对话框。此时，代理并没有停止，而是切换到 GUI 交互模式，单击“是，我信任作者”按钮，并完成界面上的其余后续操作 - 确保工作区完全进入可用状态。This case primarily demonstrates a VS Code workspace management task: “adding /home/user/data1 and /home/user/data2 to the current workspace”. During execution, the agent first directly invokes the tool capability “addfolder” to add each of the two folders to the current VS Code window. This step highlights the efficiency and determinism of tool calls when handling structured editing tasks. Subsequently, although the core objective had already been accomplished via the tool calls, VS Code presented a "Do you trust the authors?" trust confirmation dialog. Rather than stalling at this point, the agent switched to GUI interaction mode, clicked the "Yes, I trust the authors" button, and completed the remaining follow-up actions on the interface — ensuring the workspace was fully brought into a usable state.

这个案例表明系统不依赖于单一的交互范例。工具调用非常适合直接完成定义明确的编辑操作，而 GUI 操作可以处理工具无法完全覆盖的场景，例如弹出对话框、权限确认和界面状态最终确定。通过将两者结合起来，代理不仅能够高效地完成主要任务，而且能够在真实桌面环境中关闭执行后交互的循环。This case demonstrates that the system does not rely on a single interaction paradigm. Tool calls are well-suited for directly completing well-defined editing operations, while GUI actions can handle scenarios that tools cannot fully cover — such as pop-up dialogs, permission confirmations, and interface state finalization. By combining the two, the agent is not only able to complete the primary task efficiently, but also capable of closing the loop on post-execution interactions within a real desktop environment.

分析：Analysis:“我目前正在使用 LibreOffice Writer 编写 Linux 教程，我打算显示在 /home/user 中执行 l̈sc̈ommand 生成的结果。请执行此命令并将终端屏幕截图保存为桌面上的‘ls.png’。”此案例旨在为 Linux 教程生成视觉证据：代理需要在 /home/user 中运行 ls 并将终端屏幕截图保存为桌面上的 ls.png。关键步骤包括打开终端、执行命令、捕获并保存屏幕截图、检查生成的图像、保存 LibreOffice 文档以及将任务标记为完成。每个步骤都有助于将用户的指令转化为实际的基于文件的结果。“I am currently utilizing LibreOffice Writer to compose a Linux tutorial, and I intend to display the outcomes generated by executing the l̈sc̈ommand in /home/user. Kindly execute this command and save the screenshot of the terminal as ’ls.png’ on the Desktop.” This case aims to generate visual evidence for a Linux tutorial: the agent needs to run ls in /home/user and save a terminal screenshot as ls.png on the Desktop. The key steps include opening the terminal, executing the command, capturing and saving the screenshot, checking the generated image, saving the LibreOffice document, and marking the task as complete. Each step contributes to turning the user’s instruction into an actual file-based result.

Use exactly ’yellow’, no variations such as light yellow, dark yellow, or any other color.”. This is a typical case where tools are available to boost execution efficiency. E 数据管道中使用的提示Prompts Used in Data Pipeline

本节列出了离线交错 GUI 工具轨迹缩放管道中使用的提示。 顺序如下： 屏幕截图描述提示总结了原始 UI 状态； TOOL GENERATION PROMPT 提出工具库； FIX TOOL PROMPT 修复无效的工具定义；联合生成提示生成逐步的刀具轨迹； PREDICT SCREENSHOT PROMPT 和 DESCRIBE AND LOCATE PROMPT 支持状态预测和屏幕截图接地； MERGE TREE PLANNING PROMPT 与 BOTTOM UP MERGE PROMPT 一起通过将细粒度的步骤合并到较粗略的工具中来构建自下而上的层次结构。This section lists the prompts used in our Offline Interleaved GUI-Tool Trajectory Scaling Pipeline. The sequence is as follows: SCREENSHOT DESCRIPTION PROMPT summarizes raw UI states; TOOL GENERATION PROMPT proposes the tool library; FIX TOOL PROMPT repairs invalid tool definitions; JOINT GENERATION PROMPT generates step-by-step tool trajectories; PREDICT SCREENSHOT PROMPT and DESCRIBE AND LOCATE PROMPT support state prediction and screenshot grounding; and MERGE TREE PLANNING PROMPT together with BOTTOM UP MERGE PROMPT builds the bottom-up hierarchy by merging fine-grained steps into coarser tools.
